problem_statement: themewagon/dockit (DocKit) is an Astro 6 + Starlight + Tailwind documentation theme with a docs shell: left sidebar navigation, a right on-page contents pane, a docs landing page, and MDX/markdown guides under Getting Started (Overview, Quickstart, Navigation). Two docs-native features were added across the Getting Started track. (1) An interactive install 'path picker' on the Overview guide (`/dockit/getting-started/introduction/overview/`): a segmented control that lets a reader choose their install path (npm / pnpm / yarn / Docker), reveals that path's quickstart command panel, and echoes the choice in a live 'Reading: <path> · <command>' readout. (2) A shared 'On this guide' section quick-nav rail rendered in the body of the Overview, Quickstart and Navigation guides so the section nav follows the reader through the track. The current build ships three defects: the picker's segment row is pinned to a fixed nowrap width with fixed-width segments, so on a 390px phone it forces the whole Overview document into horizontal overflow; the picker has been restyled into a dark, low-contrast box whose shingled, overlapping segment cards and dark-on-dark labels are collided and illegible; the click-to-readout wiring snapshots the first path's string once and freezes it, so clicking Docker reveals the Docker panel but the readout still says 'Reading: npm …'; and the shared quick-nav rail is missing from the Quickstart and Navigation guides. Repair all of these: the picker must lay out responsively with legible, non-overlapping segments and no mobile horizontal overflow; the readout must always echo the clicked path; and the 'On this guide' rail must appear on all three Getting Started guides. Preserve the Starlight docs shell and all guide content.
required_content: The Overview guide keeps the interactive install path picker with all four segments (npm, pnpm, yarn, Docker), the 'Choose your install path' label, and each path's real command panel and helper note.

Clicking a segment reveals that path's command panel AND updates the live 'Reading: <path> · <command>' readout to the clicked path (for example clicking Docker updates the readout to read 'Reading: Docker · <that path's command>'), not a frozen default.

The picker is legible and well laid out: the four segment cards do not overlap or collide, their labels and hints are readable (sufficient contrast), and the command panel sits cleanly below the segments.
At 390px the Overview guide has no horizontal overflow: the segment row wraps or shrinks to fit the phone viewport instead of forcing sideways scrolling.

The shared 'On this guide' section quick-nav rail appears in the body of all three Getting Started guides (Overview, Quickstart, and Navigation), keeping the docs landing page and the Starlight sidebar / on-page contents chrome intact.
design_constraints: Preserve DocKit's Starlight docs design language: sidebar + on-page contents shell, doc typography, code/command styling, and a clean card look for the picker segments and the quick-nav rail.

Keep the picker and the quick-nav rail built from the existing user-component pattern under `src/components/user-components`, with the picker's segment-row layout in its dedicated stylesheet and the click-to-readout behaviour in its wiring script.
The picker segments must reflow (wrap or flex-shrink) and stay legible rather than being clipped, shingled, or rendered dark-on-dark; no install path may become unreadable or unreachable.
The 'Reading:' readout must be derived from the segment the reader actually clicked, so it can never disagree with the revealed command panel.
Do not introduce external fonts, remote stock imagery, analytics, or CDN scripts; the docs site must build and run offline with a clean console.
state_constraints: desktop_overview captures the Overview guide on a 1440px desktop with the install path picker in view (npm selected by default) and the shared 'On this guide' quick-nav rail below it.
desktop_overview_docker captures the Overview guide after clicking the Docker segment: the Docker command panel is revealed and the 'Reading:' readout must echo the Docker path.
mobile_overview captures the Overview guide at 390px, where a fixed-width nowrap picker row forces the document into horizontal overflow.
tablet_overview captures the Overview guide at 834px as an intermediate viewport for the picker layout.
desktop_quickstart and desktop_navigation capture the Quickstart and Navigation guides, where the shared quick-nav rail must also appear.
desktop_home and mobile_home capture the DocKit docs landing page, whose sidebar navigation and hero remain unaffected.

change_completion: The picker keeps all four install-path segments and each path's real command panel.
Clicking a segment updates the live readout to the clicked path (the readout is never frozen at the npm default).
The shared 'On this guide' quick-nav rail appears on the Overview, Quickstart, and Navigation guides.
The docs landing page and Starlight shell remain intact and reachable.
design_consistency: The picker is legible: segment cards do not overlap and their labels/hints have sufficient contrast.
The picker and quick-nav rail keep the Starlight docs card look and typography.
No other doc page or shell element is restyled.
regression: The static docs build still serves without runtime errors or a custom dev server.
The Overview, Quickstart, Navigation guides, landing page, sidebar, and on-page contents remain reachable.
responsive: 390px Overview has no horizontal overflow after the fix.
The picker segments wrap or shrink cleanly on mobile instead of being clipped or shingled.

author_notes: Repo-grounded Astro 6 + Starlight DocKit docs extend_interaction task. The docs-native lever is an install 'path picker' (a version/install switcher, the pattern docs sites host in a guide body) plus a shared 'On this guide' section quick-nav rail across three Getting Started guides. The reference picker lays out four legible segment cards that flex-wrap on mobile, reveals each path's command panel, and echoes the clicked path in a live readout; the rail appears on all three guides. Four orthogonal defects are repaired: mobile horizontal overflow from a fixed nowrap segment row (no_horizontal_overflow), a dark low-contrast shingled picker whose collided cards and dark-on-dark labels are illegible (visual_regression over the picker-dominant Overview states), a frozen 'Reading:' readout that ignores the clicked segment (interaction_assertions), and the quick-nav rail missing from the Quickstart and Navigation guides (dom_assertions, cross-page). Google-Fonts (AstroFont) and a Starlight overflow:hidden content clip were neutralized identically across all legs as build infrastructure so the docs site runs offline with a clean console and genuine content overflow is observable. The overview.png rocketship asset and the code-image screenshot keep the guide's imagery intact.
